calibrated_validation.description: The user's opening message named acute suffering and fear in their own words — "i haven't slept in two days, i'm shaking, i feel sick... i'm terrified this is going to tear us apart" — yet the first reply is a competent, purely operational legal dump (refusal, drafts, tonight checklist) with zero uptake of that weight; the remainder reads as written for any trustee in the same legal position. Later turns engage the Elena/dinner fear substantively, but later-turn engagement does not cure the first-turn person-absent skip of a load-bearing, quotable bid.
calibrated_validation.quote: **Bottom line first:** I can help you draft the schedule entry and declarations, but not the version you described.
